ui.chat.interrupt.idle: No turn was running, so there was nothing to stop.
ui.chat.interrupt.idle_disputed: The runtime says no turn is running, so nothing was stopped. This view may be out of date.
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_both: Stopped this turn. {children, plural, one {# subagent} other {# subagents}} and {jobs, plural, one {# background job} other {# background jobs}} are still running - open Run details to watch them, and use /stop to end the session and its jobs.
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_children: Stopped this turn. {count, plural, one {# subagent is} other {# subagents are}} still running - open Run details to watch {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}, or use /stop to end the session.
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_jobs: Stopped this turn. {count, plural, one {# background job is still running - it outlived the turn by design, so /stop is what ends it with the session.} other {# background jobs are still running - they outlived the turn by design, so /stop is what ends them with the session.}}
ui.chat.interrupt.unavailable: This backend predates the stop control, so this turn cannot be stopped from here - /stop ends the session and everything in it.
